ladder_steps.translation: barely visible or audible, with very little force
giving only weak light, so that things are hard to see clearly
easy to see, with a steady and undistorted light
giving strong light that is easily noticed
shining with intense light, as if burning

explanation: These words form a ladder of brightness, from a barely visible glimmer up to a light so intense that it seems to burn, with each step stronger than the one before.
